svg.text: Prompt 2.2, “Break my search (critique mode)”, from prompts/02_search.md (excerpt, verbatim).
Act as a skeptical information specialist.
Your task is NOT to rewrite this search strategy.
Identify how it could fail to retrieve relevant studies.
Rank the three most important failure risks, each with:
what could be missed, why, and a test I can run.
Do not modify the query yet.
